stories.title: Facade Input Schema Alignment with Tool Models
stories.description: Align EvaluateCare facade method signatures with Pydantic tool models for clinical trials and provider detail inputs, ensuring strict validation and compatibility with tool_router dispatch.

stories.title: Facade Integration with Tool Router
stories.description: Register EvaluateCare facade operations in tool_router with allowlisted tool definitions, ensuring correct routing, input validation, and response handling within the agentic loop.

stories.title: Facade Wiring into FastAPI Entry Point
stories.description: Wire EvaluateCare facade into main.py service container and ensure availability within the chat execution loop, including dependency injection and lifecycle management.

stories.title: Facade Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit tests for facade orchestration logic and integration tests covering end-to-end flows (tool_router → facade → domain services), including success, validation failure, and downstream service failure scenarios.
